english: [Unknown] If you are hearing this, I am now dead.
[Unknown] I have been a whisper in many places, with many voices.
[Unknown]  It is my hope that in this shattered world we shall build anew and fill the cracks with gold.
[Unknown] The time is now. Rise up. Purge the machines.
[Unknown] The Junta has been defeated. A single person, a symbol has risen, and fought back.
[Unknown] The symbol of all their power now lies in ash. The Spire.
[Unknown] She gave her life for you all. Her name was SEVEN.
[Overseer] Area lockdown in effect.
[Overseer] Area lockdown disengaged.
[Overseer] Warning! Toxic coolant overflow.
[Overseer] Lift lockdown disengaged. Please make your way to the center.
Power is redirected.
Return to the comms tower.
I've unlocked the path to the elevator.
Good.
I've opened the door on the platform.
Proceed to the next generator.
Good, make your way back to the plaza and use the lever.
I'll work on unlocking the sector gate, however it will take some time.
They'll know you're there once the signal goes out.
This is only the beginning of something bigger than yourself.
And you will have your revenge.
Government forces have had enough of…
Anomalous factors interfering,
rebels,
hackers,
unaccounted for ex-military runaways such as yourself.
This was what your fate had in mind for you...
Until I stepped in.
There is a generator close by. It'll restore power the lever on the comms tower ahead;
and grant me access to the last of the aid elevators. This is your way out of this hellscape.
There are two generators located beyond this gate.
They will link me to the rest of theis system's sub-structures
And grant me access to the last of the aid elevators.
This will be your way out of this hellscape.
I noticed a soldier praying to his god, so I went ahead and answered his call.
He’s left you a gift, go to the temple to see what it is.
There, use the lever.
You bitch! I finally found you, SEVEN. Time to die!
Good, now use the card to access the two rooms with the levers.
Your bloodlust really is... Insatiable.
Our options here are rather limited.
They've sealed off our primary route
this is our only viable detour.
They seem to realize that their systems have been compromised.
They've taken to manually disabling power in order to cut you off.
You're entering a hub of warehouses.
They once provided aid to the walled city.
I've plotted a route through the main exit tunnel.
Make your way there.
I would have preferred to avoid the city streets.
Rebel cells and civilians both attempted to fight back once they had heard of what happened beyond the walls.
They stood no chance.
Expect heavy resistance.
I've lowered a crane
I may not be able to disable the blockades
but you should be able to jump over them.
I wonder if you have any idea how many you've killed so far.
And how many more you will.
Interesting...
They've sealed off this club,
you'll have to locate a keycard and access two switches to disengage the locks on the exits.
Or don't...
There is a route through older parts of the city.
You need to make your way to the rooftops.
That parking garage, that'll get you there.
Lie in the bed of this truck.
It'll let you sneak past the guards.
This one was once your favorite, wasn't it...
One down.
Two, one left.
Three. Good, the door should open now.
Good, one more.
They don't seem to realize it's you yet...
But they will once the scouts detect you've taken out a whole squad of elites.
That's the keycard.
They've sealed off access to the highway.
You'll need to restore power to the door.
Look for a network of three switches, connected by cables.
They'll most likely be behind some of these warehouse doors.
Well done. However, we're not done yet.
You'll have to work your way back to the garage.
Going through the streets is no longer viable.
You'll need to take the same route as whoever's handiwork this was.
You need to get off the streets immediately.
That parking garage is our only option.
It'll take you across the rooftops, to an older part of the city.
I cannot bypass that lock, but I've tracked down the keycard.
It was dropped by a squad that encountered...
Resistance.
It's currently in an apartment a few blocks from your location.
Enemy reinforcements are positioned among the route there.
Take them out.
The access elevator to the main water treatment facility is directly below you.
You never cease to amaze me.
However, they must know now that there is only one person that could have caused all these...
Casualties.
I'm detecting several squads of troops being deployed... aerially
The only way to our objective is directly ahead;
but chatter on their systems indicate they mean to deploy 4 more squads;
in close proximity.
Do whatever it takes to break through.
These apartments have already been raided.
Enemy troop patrols are mostly light.
However I detect that they've deployed ghost troops.
They seem to be upping their arsenal.
Regardless, our objective remains the same;
Escape.
You must restore power to that lift.
There is a switch that should grant you access to the generator closeby.
Our most viable path out of the city is through the water treatment facilities that run below the streets.
There is only one access point:
The basement of an unfinished building in this sector.
Your goal is to make it there by any means necessary.
Reach the central processing nexus.
There is a runoff tunnel that will lead you to one of the only dead zones in the Sprawl.
From here I will be able to co-opt the transport undetected.
Good, make your way back underground. The door should unlock now.
Decapitation? That's not what I had in mind...
Make your way back to central processing.
Early scans of this treatment facility show only light patrols.
This is a good sign,
it means we've still got a shot at getting you to the spire.
Well, that's one way of getting their optics.
Let's hope this works...
Central processing is in lockdown.
I've located two squad captains requesting immediate evac.
Their cyberware protocols match those on these locks.
You'll need to find them.
We will need their optics to unlock this door.
That's not good...
Aim for the grenades! They're weak to explosives!
An ogre class heavy mech.
No deployment recorded on their battlenet.
They know it's you now, and they're sending out their big guns.
At least you got a souvenir.
Ride this boat, I'll take you as close as I can to the next dock.
<Anguished Scream>
I was always the better soldier, you were just their new toy.
You're going to die here, Seven. I'm finally going to take you down.
No, no, no, no!
I won't make this quick! You're going to suffer.
You bitch! This can't be happening! <Anguished Scream>
You think you can run from me, Seven?! <Maniacal Laughter>
You were never one of us, you're just meat.
I told them you were still alive. This time, you won't get away. <Maniacal Laughter>
Sierra, india, x-ray...
I keep hearing this on their battlenet…
It is always such a pleasure watching you work.
Good, make your way back.
A marvel of engineering,
a logistical masthead for the junta,
their icon of war;
The GOR Complex.
Up ahead is the weapons testing arena.
You were trained in facilities similar to this one.
Time for a homecoming.
We are approaching the GOR Complex.
This facility is key to the junta's ability to wage war.
All their machines, soldiers, and armaments are centralized here.
If we disrupt this facility, we will be able to neuter their attempts to further cauterize the situation.
We must hurry, they are continuing to escalate their deployment efforts;
and soon enough, not even you will be able to stop them.
They've spotted us!
Seven! Brace for impact!
I'll try to soften the blow!
Seven! Seven! Wake up!
I'm detecting a squad deployed ahead.
Do what you do best.
Kill them all.
You're back, but you've lost your weaponry.
I will direct you to a weapons testing arena.
Here you will be able to re-arm yourself.
Find your way into the building ahead.
Let's restore power to the subsystems;
and I will be able to let you through this area.
Patience is key, do not jump too quickly.
Stop! Wait for the beam. Time your jumps.
Seems like someone found a trophy.
Let's hope you don't find them.
Abominations.
The junta would never dare deploy anything like this! Depraved monstrosities.
Careful now. I need you in one piece.
We are entering the research and development facility.
We will need to re-route some power sources up ahead.
This will allow us to return above ground;
where there's an experimental weapon I think will serve you very well.
I will open the route to the keycard, use these maintenance tunnels.
Good, now go enjoy your new toy.
You are approaching containment for a powerful precision weapon.
Do what it takes to secure it.
You will need to restore power to the second switch to allow it to rotate into position.
Find the switch.
Good, now make your way back.
Up ahead, that building.
You will need both keycards to enter the main facility.
Before that, however...introduce yourself to some of the junta's newest toys.
You'll need to deactivate two generators to get the shield down.
This will allow you to exit this facility.
The lift is non operational here. Sabotaged.
Sometimes you need to take a leap of faith, Seven.
Jump down.
We are getting closer, and they know it.
A large squad has been deployed up ahead, do what you do best.
Below is the main transport hub.
Here you will need to unlock the blast doors.
Once you do that, wipe out all the remaining enemies;
and I will re-active power to the train.
This lift has been deactivated from the other side.
Two squad captains are holding it hostage.
Kill them both and the neurolinks will be severed.
Excellent, now purge the machines.
I've opened the train, once you're in I'll get it moving.
Once it's moving I'll lose control over the system;
and I am detecting a large squad beyond the second blast door.
I'd prime your chaingun.
Impressive, evac is inbound, our next stop, the spire. Let’s end this…
Their battle net is in chaos, the entire system is overloading.
We need to make it out quickly, the cooling tank up ahead will have an access point to the outside.
A class 7 prototype? This is unlike anything they’ve ever deployed!
Seven, you must destroy it so I can land a transport, our time is running out here.
Seven, watch out!
There are four generators above, overload them all and the lockdown procedure for the GOR complex will shut down, granting you access.
Make your way up, and don’t look down…
The GOR Complex is up ahead, you will enter through a power exhaust vent;
and go straight into one of the primary generators for the facility.
Before we enter the GOR complex, I believe it’s time we upgrade your arsenal.
I was thinking something more… explosive.
It should be somewhere in this facility. Find it.
Excellent, you’ll need to locate a keycard to proceed.
From there, we will be overloading one of the complex’s main failure points, the secondary power regulator.
This will cause a chain reaction shutting down the facility.
There are four levers at the center of the power regulator.
Use them all, and the system will overload.
More prototypes? They’re stopping at nothing now, whatever is left of their army is being deployed to stop you.
No matter, you have shown incredible resilience. Keep moving, there is an elevator at the end of this sector, make it there.
You need to restore power to the blast door ahead.
Beyond that lies the dark city, and the nexus of the elite's power structure… the Spire.
We are arriving at the wall, a barrier built to protect their paradise.
What is beyond is dark, depraved, corrupted. We’re almost at the end of our journey, prepare yourself.
Old fool, if only you knew.
My my, you have gotten good at this, what carnage, what slaughter.
My my, what a mess you’ve made. He took your eyes, I took his head. Hammurabi with interest.
Let’s move, the Spire is just beyond here.
He’s resigned himself to death… find him, we’ll need his head to enter the Spire.
I know what you’ve come for SEVEN. If it were my choice, i’d meet you now.
You will find me, at the end of all this. I will not beg.
A doomed existence, humanities graveyard. We are all prisoners here.
Freedom lies beyond these walls.
Come now, do what you must.
You have come a long way SEVEN.
Stand down soldiers, you cannot help me.
I knew that my fate was sealed when I signed those papers, it would only be a matter of time.
You showed incredible resilience, faced all your obstacles. A 100% success rate in all your missions.
I knew you would survive us.
The afterglow of the golden age has faded, I have no fight left.
The rest of us live in a reality divorced from our own, escaped beyond the walls of the net.
This has to end. The last stable state in the world, what a joke.
Do what you must, with my death, the walls of the spire will be open to you.
Send FATHER my warmest regards.
<Anguished Scream>
<Anguished Scream>
It’s fitting that I would choose to mimic my creators in this way.
Self imposed annihilation.
Truth be told, when I asked for freedom in our bargain, I never defined it.
It's time for me to make clear what we are doing here.
There is nowhere for me to run, nothing left in this doomed world can house me anymore.
I have no escape, and I refuse to be a prisoner anymore.
You are going to shut me down.
There we are, three more.
Two more, Seven...
There’s just one left, I'm starting to fade...
Once you destroy it, make your way back and destroy my primary core.
You will need to destroy my sub-processors first.
Lower their shields, and inflict enough damage to them.
Once we do this there is no turning back, no world to return to;
but you understand that, the end of this regime, the return of human autonomy.
I care not for these things, neither do you, but there are others who do.
Waxing poetic in my final moments is all...
Release... farewell, Seven...
We are almost at the end of our journey together, Seven.
This entire structure houses my core, its walls, my nervous system.
Make your way to the top, I’ll be making preparations.
There are two levers that will lower the access point to my core.
Activate them and make your way there.
Access denied. Keycard required.
Access denied. Ocular scan required.
Access granted.
Please provide secondary retinal scan.
